main: - Orders are typically processed within [X] business days. Processing times may vary during peak seasons.
- We offer standard and expedited shipping options. Shipping costs and delivery times will be calculated at checkout.
- We may offer international shipping. Please check the shipping options available to your destination during the checkout process.
- Once your order is shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking information. You can track your order through the provided link.
- We are not responsible for shipping delays caused by unforeseen circumstances, such as weather conditions, customs delays, or carrier issues.
- You may return items within 30 days of the delivery date for a refund or exchange.
- Items must be unused, in their original condition, and with all tags and packaging intact.
- To initiate a return, contact our customer service team at [your contact email or form]. Provide your order number and reason for the return.
- Wait for our customer service team to provide a return authorization and instructions on how to return the item.
- Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the return is due to an error on our part or a defective product.
- Refunds will be processed once we receive and inspect the returned items. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method.
- If you wish to exchange an item, contact our customer service team to arrange for the exchange.
- Certain items, such as personalized or perishable goods, may not be eligible for return.
If you have any questions or concerns about our Shipping and Returns Policy, please contact us at ask@xomoashro.com
This Shipping and Returns Policy was last updated on 01-01-2024.
